milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The light_gray_concrete path center is at approximately (0, -1, 5) spawn-relative. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm visual identification. max_distance=10 is generous since the path starts just 2 blocks from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta_banner is placed at (0, 0, 10) spawn-relative. The player must navigate within 5 blocks and face toward it, confirming they have located the banner at the structure entrance. max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked most of the path to reach the banner area.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined item ends up in inventory. A Silk Touch diamond pickaxe is provided in the scene, so magenta_stained_glass_pane drops itself when broken. Multiple panes are available in the structure walls at z=11 and z=14.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined item ends up in inventory. A Silk Touch diamond pickaxe is provided in the scene, so purple_stained_glass drops itself when broken. Multiple purple glass blocks are available in the structure walls at z=11 and z=14.
